# The labels server/internal/node/node.go's Node.handleMethod may have for methods that are not bound to a session,
# frozen (#12920): server/internal/archguard/central_lists_test.go fails on any other. Such a method registers from an
# init() in its domain's own file, func init() { nodeRPC(name, (*Node).x) } (docs/server/architecture.md "Registering a
# domain's entries"). A label is its source text; a prefix handleMethod routes on is `prefix <text>`. Session-bound
# labels, delivery aliases and labels under a reserved prefix are not listed: they stay in the switch.
# Delete a line once the test's notice names it; add none.
